messages:
Lena Ortiz: quick a11y sweep of the Models page toolbar on small screens — tab order goes weird when toolbar is bottom-docked. Tab lands in content, then toolbar, then back to content. Feels unexpected.
Diego Morales: is it appended at the end of DOM via portal? That would explain the flow.
Lena Ortiz: yes portal appends to body. Visual position is bottom, DOM order is last child.
Rina Sato: for keyboard/AT the logical order matters. Options: move toolbar earlier in DOM and absolutely position it, or add a "Skip to toolbar" link at top.
a11y-bot: auto-check: toolbar buttons contrast 3.2:1 (fails 4.5), missing footer role="contentinfo", focus outline 2px (recommend >=3px).
Evan Li: practical fix: add a skip link + ensure toolbar container has tabindex="-1" so skip focuses the first control inside. Also increase focus ring to 3px and pick a high-contrast token.
Diego Morales: alternative: reparent toolbar in DOM order when visible. CSS can keep it visually bottom. Might require updating sibling selectors.
Rina Sato: change icon-only buttons to include visually-hidden text inside the button and keep svg aria-hidden. That improves reliability across screen readers. Also use aria-pressed for toggles.
Lena Ortiz: mobile rotor note: toolbar items should appear in quick nav; ensure role and accessible name are present. Make touch targets >=44px.
Evan Li: copy nit: use "Refresh models" instead of "Reload" for aria-labels/tooltips.
a11y-bot: checklist: add skip link, add role="contentinfo" to footer, embed sr-only text in toolbar buttons, bump focus ring to 3px, use --interactive-strong for button bg token.
Diego Morales: I'll prototype both approaches (skip link + DOM reordering) and run VoiceOver/NVDA tests. Will open draft PR with storybook samples + axe results.
Lena Ortiz: please include test plan: Safari+VO, Chrome+NVDA, mobile VO. Also add cypress check that skip link focuses toolbar first control.
Rina Sato: + add a visual spec for focus-visible and confirm color tokens meet contrast.
Diego Morales: got it. Targeting draft by EOD. Ping me to join testing. :mag:
